## Acceptance Criteria → Test Case Coverage
| AC | Criterion | Test cases | Covered |
|----|-----------|------------|---------|
| AC-1 | Register & login Route Handlers replace backend routes/controllers; both set JWT in an httpOnly cookie on success (never a body field stored in localStorage) | TC-API-01, TC-API-02, TC-API-03, TC-API-09, TC-INT-01, TC-SEC-01, TC-SEC-02, TC-SEC-03, TC-E2E-01 | ✅ |
| AC-2 | Middleware + auth.js verify the cookie on protected routes and attach the user; public endpoints still pass through (soft auth) | TC-API-07, TC-API-08, TC-INT-02, TC-INT-03, TC-SEC-07, TC-SEC-08, TC-E2E-01, TC-E2E-02, TC-E2E-03 | ✅ |
| AC-3 | Error class hierarchy (MyError/ForbiddenError/NotFoundError/UnauthorizedError) ported to lib/errors.js; shared helpers (slugify, appendFollowers, appendFavorites, appendTagList) to lib/helpers.js | TC-API-10 (error hierarchy via observable HTTP mapping) | ✅ (partial — see Open Questions on helper observability) |
| AC-4 | Startup calls sequelize.authenticate() only — never sequelize.sync({alter:true}); schema managed by existing Sequelize CLI migrations | TC-INT-04 | ✅ |
| AC-5 | Full auth flow E2E: register -> login -> cookie set -> subsequent cookie request resolves correct user; error responses on invalid credentials match `{errors:{body:[...]}}` | TC-API-04, TC-API-05, TC-API-06, TC-API-10, TC-E2E-01, TC-E2E-02, TC-E2E-03, TC-SEC-06 | ✅ |

**Coverage check**: 5/5 acceptance criteria have at least one test case. ✅
Every AC also has at least one happy-path AND one negative/boundary case: AC-1 (TC-API-01 happy / TC-API-02, TC-API-03 negative), AC-2 (TC-API-08 happy / TC-API-07, TC-SEC-07/08 negative), AC-3 (TC-API-10 mixed happy+negative mappings), AC-4 (TC-INT-04 positive / TC-INT-05 negative-adjacent + the "no schema mutation" assertion is itself the boundary), AC-5 (TC-E2E-01 happy / TC-API-05, TC-E2E-02 negative).

## Open Questions
- TO CONFIRM (dev): exact session cookie **name** (assumed `token` throughout) — needed for TC-SEC-07 tampering and cookie-replay cases.
- TO CONFIRM (dev): success **status code** for register (200 vs 201) — TC-API-01.
- TO CONFIRM (dev/BA): whether the Conduit `user.token` body field is **removed entirely** or retained for backward-compat but never persisted client-side — TC-API-01, TC-SEC-02. AC-1's constraint is specifically about localStorage persistence.
- TO CONFIRM (dev): exact **status code** for invalid login (401 vs 422 vs 403) — TC-API-05, TC-SEC-06.
- TO CONFIRM (dev): the exact **current-user endpoint path** (assumed `GET /api/user`) and which endpoints are **protected** vs **public (soft-auth)** — TC-API-06/07/08, TC-INT-02/03.
- TO CONFIRM (dev): the **SameSite** value and whether **Secure** is set unconditionally or environment-gated; the cookie **lifetime** — TC-SEC-01.
- TO CONFIRM (dev): whether an **Authorization/Token header** is still an accepted auth path alongside the cookie, or the cookie is the only session mechanism — TC-SEC-08.
- TO CONFIRM (dev): is there a **logout endpoint** (`POST /api/users/logout`) that clears the cookie — TC-E2E-02.
- TO CONFIRM (dev): exact Sequelize **table/column names** for the users table (from the migrations, not source) — TC-INT-01, TC-INT-05.
